title: Model-picker favorites: record every selection, rank most-recent-first
context: User: 'favorite models in new session rarely gets updated... I selected a model - next time i see it there. ALWAYS.' Root causes: (1) recordSpawnChoice only fired on successful spawn; (2) picks endpoint returned top-8 by count only, so a new one-off pick was invisible.
decision: New-session model-picker favorites now record on EVERY deliberate selection and rank most-recent-first. (1) static/app.js: recordSpawnChoice() hooks at the end of setSpawnDefaultModel success path, setSpawnEngine(v, opts) (record defaults true), the $convInputEffortSelect change handler, and selectSpawnPick (pill clicks). (2) setSpawnEngine gained an opts param; automatic call sites pass {record: false}: failed-spawn retry (~18260), CLI-unavailable auto-fallback (~63625), spawn restore (~74434). (3) ccc_server/log_parse.py get_model_picker_picks() (~476-496): ordering changed from pure count-desc to most-recently-recorded key first + remaining by count desc, still capped at 8. Commits f326c874 (hooks) + 051de718 (ranking + guard), both unpushed.
consequences: Pills reorder on every selection — that is the requested 'always up-to-date' behavior
The on-disk picks format is unchanged; only GET ordering changed
Automatic engine fallbacks (CLI unavailable, failed-spawn retry) must keep passing {record:false} — new setSpawnEngine call sites need a deliberate choice
alternatives_rejected: Record only on actual spawn (status quo — favorites rarely changed)
Pure count ranking (a one-off selection of a new model could never appear in top 8)
Pure MRU ranking (lost the habitual-picks signal)
Recording from setSpawnEngine with no opt-out (auto-fallback paths would pollute favorites with picks the user never made)
